subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm the details of your upcoming flight booking from New York to London on May 15th, 2022. Your flight is scheduled for departure at 9:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please ensure that you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the departure time. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
